page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. Additionally, there are no integrated GPUs, and the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile of the ecs.s2.large presents several technical constraints. CPU instruction set extensions such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI) are unavailable on this instance type. This lack of specialized instruction sets limits its efficiency for vector math, machine learning inference, and hardware-accelerated encryption tasks. The 4.0 GB memory capacity also restricts the instance to lightweight processes, as memory-intensive applications may encounter resource exhaustion.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.s2.large is positioned as a budget-friendly option for workloads with low resource demands. Because it utilizes dedicated CPU allocation rather than a burstable model, it provides predictable, albeit modest, compute performance. This makes the instance suitable for basic utility workloads, lightweight web serving, development and testing environments, small-scale databases, and simple background tasks that do not require high memory density, local storage, or hardware acceleration.
